### AppReleaseArtifactReader

```ts
type AppReleaseArtifactReader = object;
```

Effect-native artifact reader port.

A reader result is hostile until the App Release core decodes it through its
canonical schema. This port owns the only direct unknown success value.

### AppReleaseStorePortFailure

```ts
type AppReleaseStorePortFailure =
  | AppReleaseStoreFailure
  | {
      kind: "invalid-store-result";
    };
```

Closed failures emitted by the owned Effect Store port.

The invalid-result sentinel lets the outer Promise adapter fail closed when a
foreign fulfilled value is not one of the catalog's durable outcomes.

### AppReleaseStore

```ts
type AppReleaseStore = object;
```

Implementations own atomicity; the catalog owns the interpretation of these
explicit outcomes. This port intentionally has no generic query or mutation

```ts
>;
```

## Functions

### createAppReleaseCore()

```ts
function createAppReleaseCore(options): AppReleaseCore;
```

Compose the Effect-native App Release core.

A Release is first compared with its existing immutable record. Only an absent
Release requires an owner App lookup and an atomic create-or-observe. Every
closed store failure is mapped at this boundary.

#### Parameters

| Parameter                 | Type                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| ------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `options`                 | \{ `store`: [`AppReleaseStore`](#appreleasestore); `artifactReader`: [`AppReleaseArtifactReader`](#appreleaseartifactreader); `artifactPolicy?`: `Readonly`\<\{ `maxBytes`: `number`; `maxManifestBytes?`: `number`; \}\>; \} |
| `options.store`           | [`AppReleaseStore`](#appreleasestore)                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| `options.artifactReader`  | [`AppReleaseArtifactReader`](#appreleaseartifactreader)                                                                                                                                                                       |
| `options.artifactPolicy?` | `Readonly`\<\{ `maxBytes`: `number`; `maxManifestBytes?`: `number`; \}\>                                                                                                                                                      |

#### Returns

[`AppReleaseCore`](#appreleasecore)

### createDeterministicMemoryAppReleaseStore()

```ts
function createDeterministicMemoryAppReleaseStore(
  options?,
): PromiseAppReleaseStore;
```

Compose an in-process deterministic store for the narrow App/Release port.

Store methods mutate only the private collections below. Decisions remain in
pure helpers, and every returned record is copied, so callers cannot mutate
retained state after an atomic create-or-observe operation.

#### Parameters

| Parameter                         | Type                                                                                                                                                                    |
| --------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `options`                         | \{ `routes`: \{ `platformRoutes`: readonly `object`[]; `structuralRoutes`: readonly [`StableRoute`](index.md#stableroute)[]; \}; `publishers?`: readonly `object`[]; \} |
| `options.routes`                  | \{ `platformRoutes`: readonly `object`[]; `structuralRoutes`: readonly [`StableRoute`](index.md#stableroute)[]; \}                                                      |
| `options.routes.platformRoutes`   | readonly `object`[]                                                                                                                                                     |
| `options.routes.structuralRoutes` | readonly [`StableRoute`](index.md#stableroute)[]                                                                                                                        |
| `options.publishers?`             | readonly `object`[]                                                                                                                                                     |

#### Returns

[`PromiseAppReleaseStore`](index.md#promiseappreleasestore)

### adaptPromiseArtifactReader()

```ts
function adaptPromiseArtifactReader(projection): AppReleaseArtifactReader;
```

Adapt the Promise artifact-reader projection at the one outer edge.

Successful values remain hostile until the core's canonical schema decodes them.
A rejected Promise is closed to the reader's unavailable failure.
